briefdescription.para: Initialize the state with the information in the Attributor A.

detaileddescription.para:
This function is called by the Attributor once all abstract attributes have been identified. It can and shall be used for task like:
identify existing knowledge in the IR and use it for the "known state"
perform any work that is not going to change over time, e.g., determine a subset of the IR, or attributes in-flight, that have to be looked at in the updateImpl method.

briefdescription.para: The actual update/transfer function which has to be implemented by the derived classes.

detaileddescription.para: If it is called, the environment has changed and we have to determine if the current information is still valid or adjust it otherwise.
\Return CHANGED if the internal state changed, otherwise UNCHANGED.

briefdescription.para: Hook for the Attributor to trigger the manifestation of the information represented by the abstract attribute in the LLVM-IR.

detaileddescription.para: \Return CHANGED if the IR was altered, otherwise UNCHANGED.

briefdescription.para: Hook to enable custom statistic tracking, called after manifest that resulted in a change if statistics are enabled.

detaileddescription.para: We require subclasses to provide an implementation so we remember to add statistics for them.
